values: 6000001 / AMR-059-0001. Global Hessian realizations of statistical manifolds. A proper global realization of any smooth positive boundaryless statistical n-manifold and its ordered torsion-free dual pair in a positive Hessian open domain of dimension binomial(2n+4,3), n>=1; a general dual pair admits such a flat torsion-free ambient realization iff both input connections are torsion-free. The domain may be nonconvex and incomplete; no globally injective dual gradient, finite probability model, or optimal dimension is claimed.
